# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the current production branch and deployed site.
Historical snapshots and review bundles are not independently supported.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use this repository's **Report a vulnerability** link on GitHub to submit a
private vulnerability report. Do not disclose suspected vulnerabilities in a
public issue, discussion, pull request, or social-media post.

Include the affected page or component, reproduction steps, security impact,
and any safe supporting evidence. Never include live credentials, private keys,
personal data, or client confidential information.

The maintainer will acknowledge a complete report, assess its scope, and
coordinate remediation and disclosure through the private report.
